A.K.M. Asaduzzaman, J. This rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the accused petitioner should not be enlarged on bail in G.R. Case No.12 of 2008 arising out of Chatmohar P.S. Case No.3 dated 22.2.2008 under section 143/447/323/325/302/34 of the Penal Code, now pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Pabna. 

 The petitioner was brought to the trial in a case under section 143/447/323/325/302/34 of the Penal Code.
